prompt: The attached image is a 240x240 px frame from an animated GIF. Rebuild the scene in 3D with three.js. Task (3D, static): write an HTML page that builds the scene from code and renders it so that the view from your reference camera reproduces the image as faithfully as you can: characters, poses, facial expressions, hands, props, background, and colors. A later step will animate your scene, so structure it in named groups. For this static step, render(t) may ignore t. three.js contract: - The harness injects an import map for three.js r187. Import from 'three' and from 'three/addons/'; the only addons available are 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ConvexGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricFunctions.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js', 'three/addons/math/ConvexHull.js', 'three/addons/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js'. Use one
html:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<style>
html,body{margin:0;padding:0;overflow:hidden;background:#000;width:240px;height:240px}
canvas{display:block;position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:240px;height:240px}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';

const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ preserveDrawingBuffer: true, antialias: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(240, 240);
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xd9c7c0);

const cam = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(30, 1, 0.1, 100);
cam.position.set(0, 1.8, 6.8);
cam.lookAt(0, 1.8, 0);

// ---------- helpers ----------
const M = (c, o = {}) => new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: c, roughness: 0.6, metalness: 0, ...o });
const sphGeo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 36, 24);
function ell(mat, rx, ry, rz, x, y, z, name) {
  const m = new THREE.Mesh(sphGeo, mat);
  m.scale.set(rx, ry, rz); m.position.set(x, y, z);
  if (name) m.name = name;
  return m;
}
function box(mat, w, h, d, x, y, z, name) {
  const m = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(w, h, d), mat);
  m.position.set(x, y, z);
  if (name) m.name = name;
  return m;
}
function limb(mat, a, b, r) {
  const d = new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(b, a);
  const L = d.length();
  const m = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(r, L, 6, 16), mat);
  m.position.copy(a).addScaledVector(d, 0.5);
  m.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), d.normalize());
  return m;
}
let seed = 7;
const rnd = () => { seed = (seed * 16807) % 2147483647; return seed / 2147483647; };

// ---------- lights ----------
scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xffffff, 0xb09070, 2.2));
const key = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 2.1); key.position.set(3, 5, 6); scene.add(key);
const fill = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff0d8, 0.6); fill.position.set(-5, 2, 3); scene.add(fill);
const back = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffe8c8, 1.2); back.position.set(-3, 4, -6); scene.add(back);

// ---------- background ----------
const bg = new THREE.Group(); bg.name = 'background'; scene.add(bg);
const wall = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(16, 10), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xdccbc4 }));
wall.position.set(0, 3, -4); wall.name = 'wall'; bg.add(wall);
const floor = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(16, 14), M(0x7d6552));
floor.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2; floor.position.set(0, 0, 1); floor.name = 'floor'; bg.add(floor);

const win = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(0.85, 4.4), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xf6f3f0 }));
win.position.set(1.5, 2.9, -3.95); win.name = 'window'; bg.add(win);

const curtGeo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(1.9, 4.4, 40, 1);
{ const p = curtGeo.attributes.position;
  for (let i = 0; i < p.count; i++) p.setZ(i, 0.09 * Math.sin(p.getX(i) * 16));
  curtGeo.computeVertexNormals(); }
const curtain = new THREE.Mesh(curtGeo, M(0xb9b5b2, { side: THREE.DoubleSide, roughness: 0.9 }));
curtain.position.set(2.8, 2.9, -3.6); curtain.name = 'curtain'; bg.add(curtain);

bg.add(box(M(0x5e4636), 1.7, 1.0, 0.5, 2.75, 0.5, -3.3, 'cabinet'));

const shelf = new THREE.Group(); shelf.name = 'bookshelf'; bg.add(shelf);
const wood = M(0x4b3628), woodDark = M(0x33241a);
shelf.add(box(woodDark, 1.1, 3.8, 0.05, -2.46, 1.9, -3.92));
shelf.add(box(wood, 0.07, 3.8, 0.45, -3.0, 1.9, -3.7));
shelf.add(box(wood, 0.07, 3.8, 0.45, -1.93, 1.9, -3.7));
[3.79, 2.5, 1.15, 0.03].forEach(y => shelf.add(box(wood, 1.12, 0.07, 0.45, -2.46, y, -3.7)));
const bookMats = [M(0xe8e4de), M(0xcfcac4), M(0xb9a58e), M(0xf2efea), M(0x9a9690)];
[2.54, 1.19, 0.07].forEach(yb => {
  let x = -2.94, i = 0;
  while (x < -2.1) {
    const w = 0.07 + rnd() * 0.08, h = 0.42 + rnd() * 0.22;
    if (rnd() > 0.15) shelf.add(box(bookMats[(i + Math.floor(rnd() * 5)) % 5], w, h, 0.3, x + w / 2, yb + h / 2, -3.62));
    x += w + 0.012; i++;
  }
});

// ---------- props ----------
const props = new THREE.Group(); props.name = 'props'; scene.add(props);
const table = new THREE.Group(); table.name = 'table'; props.add(table);
table.add(box(M(0xf2efea, { roughness: 0.4 }), 3.6, 0.08, 1.6, 0.1, 0.38, 2.15, 'table-top'));
[[-1.5, 1.5], [1.7, 1.5], [-1.5, 2.8], [1.7, 2.8]].forEach(([x, z]) => table.add(box(M(0xcfc8c0), 0.1, 0.34, 0.1, x, 0.17, z)));

// ---------- character ----------
const yellow = M(0xf0c810, { roughness: 0.5 });
const yellowDS = M(0xf0c810, { roughness: 0.5, side: THREE.DoubleSide });
const cream = M(0xe8d5b0, { roughness: 0.65 });
const handMat = M(0x4a4634, { roughness: 0.8 });
const darkMat = M(0x3a2a0a, { roughness: 0.7 });

const character = new THREE.Group(); character.name = 'character-yellow-blob';
character.position.set(0.11, 0, 0); scene.add(character);

// body
const body = new THREE.Group(); body.name = 'body'; character.add(body);
const prof = [[0, 0], [1.2, 0.02], [1.55, 0.12], [1.66, 0.35], [1.63, 0.6], [1.52, 0.87], [1.33, 1.19],
  [1.07, 1.5], [0.86, 1.82], [0.72, 2.15], [0.5, 2.45], [0, 2.6]].map(p => new THREE.Vector2(p[0], p[1]));
const profPts = new THREE.SplineCurve(prof).getPoints(56).map(p => new THREE.Vector2(Math.max(0.001, p.x), p.y));
const torso = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.LatheGeometry(profPts, 48), yellowDS);
torso.scale.set(1, 1, 0.78); torso.name = 'torso'; body.add(torso);
body.add(ell(cream, 0.72, 0.82, 0.75, -0.04, 0.7, 0.6, 'belly'));

// head
const RX = 0.72, RY = 0.7, RZ = 0.64;
const head = new THREE.Group(); head.name = 'head'; head.position.set(0.08, 2.3, 0.05); character.add(head);
head.add(ell(yellow, RX, RY, RZ, 0, 0, 0, 'skull'));

function patch(mat, x0, x1, fu, fl, off, nx = 20, ny = 5) {
  const pos = [], idx = [];
  for (let i = 0; i <= nx; i++) {
    const x = x0 + (x1 - x0) * i / nx, yu = fu(x), yl = fl(x);
    for (let j = 0; j <= ny; j++) {
      const y = yu + (yl - yu) * j / ny;
      const z = RZ * Math.sqrt(Math.max(0.01, 1 - (x / RX) ** 2 - (y / RY) ** 2));
      const n = new THREE.Vector3(x / RX / RX, y / RY / RY, z / RZ / RZ).normalize();
      pos.push(x + n.x * off, y + n.y * off, z + n.z * off);
    }
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < nx; i++) for (let j = 0; j < ny; j++) {
    const a = i * (ny + 1) + j, b = a + 1, c = a + ny + 1, d = c + 1;
    idx.push(a, b, c, b, d, c);
  }
  const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  g.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos, 3));
  g.setIndex(idx); g.computeVertexNormals();
  mat.side = THREE.DoubleSide;
  return new THREE.Mesh(g, mat);
}

// mouth
const mouth = new THREE.Group(); mouth.name = 'mouth'; head.add(mouth);
const W = 0.3;
const fu = x => -0.20 + 0.08 * (x / W) ** 2;
const fl = x => -0.12 - 0.25 * (1 - (x / W) ** 2);
const mouthIn = patch(M(0x4a1c10, { roughness: 0.8 }), -W, W, fu, fl, 0.006);
mouthIn.name = 'mouth-interior'; mouth.add(mouthIn);
const tongue = patch(M(0xc06a5a, { roughness: 0.5 }), -0.17, 0.17, x => -0.29 + 0.03 * (x / 0.17) ** 2, x => fl(x) + 0.015, 0.014, 12, 3);
tongue.name = 'tongue'; mouth.add(tongue);

// eyes
const eyes = new THREE.Group(); eyes.name = 'eyes'; head.add(eyes);
const ARC = 1.9, ER = 0.11;
[-1, 1].forEach(s => {
  const eye = new THREE.Group(); eye.name = s < 0 ? 'eye-left' : 'eye-right';
  eye.position.set(s * 0.22, 0.23, 0.56);
  eye.rotation.set(-0.31, s * 0.295, 0);
  eye.add(ell(yellow, 0.105, 0.075, 0.06, 0, 0, 0, 'eyelid'));
  const slit = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(ER, 0.014, 8, 20, ARC), darkMat);
  slit.rotation.z = -Math.PI / 2 - ARC / 2;
  slit.position.set(0, ER - 0.025, 0.05);
  slit.name = 'eye-slit'; eye.add(slit);
  eyes.add(eye);
});

// arms + hands
[-1, 1].forEach(s => {
  const arm = new THREE.Group(); arm.name = s < 0 ? 'arm-left' : 'arm-right';
  arm.position.set(s * 1.15, 1.25, 0.2); character.add(arm);
  const hx = s < 0 ? -1.1 : 1.03;
  const wrist = new THREE.Vector3(hx - s * 1.15, -0.7, 1.2);
  const elbow = new THREE.Vector3(s * 0.1, -0.55, 0.45);
  const up = limb(yellow, new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 0), elbow, 0.32); up.name = 'upper-arm'; arm.add(up);
  const fore = limb(yellow, elbow, wrist.clone().add(new THREE.Vector3(0, 0.05, -0.12)), 0.25); fore.name = 'forearm'; arm.add(fore);
  const hand = new THREE.Group(); hand.name = s < 0 ? 'hand-left' : 'hand-right';
  hand.position.copy(wrist); arm.add(hand);
  hand.add(ell(handMat, 0.2, 0.115, 0.17, 0, 0, 0, 'palm'));
  const inX = -s;
  for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
    const a = new THREE.Vector3(inX * 0.13, -0.01, -0.1 + i * 0.075);
    const b = a.clone().add(new THREE.Vector3(inX * 0.15, -0.045, 0.03 + i * 0.012));
    const f = limb(handMat, a, b, 0.045); f.name = 'finger-' + i; hand.add(f);
  }
});

// ---------- api ----------
function render(t) { renderer.render(scene, cam); }
render(0);
window.nwb = { scene, renderer, cameras: { ref: cam }, characters: [character], render, ready: true };
</script>
</body>
</html>
